abstract: Configure LangChain (Python langchain 1.x, langchain-openai, langchain-anthropic, langchain-ollama) against self-hosted OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints: vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM and llama-swap. Covers ChatOpenAI, ChatAnthropic and ChatOllama base URLs, key handling without printing secrets, env vars that silently redirect, model names and profiles, with_structured_output methods, tool calling, create_agent strategies, streaming usage, dropped reasoning content, troubleshooting, and a curl and jq probe script.
